office.note: The Godspeed Ginny is alongside, leaking gently. Reverse is unreliable. The safety valve is painted shut. Pick something to carry.

node.sellingThreat: NOTHING TO STEER. THIS ONE IS SOLD, NOT SAILED.

log.deadpan: — delivered completely straight. He is not making a joke.
log.jokeStrong: It lands. You can feel the boat lighten.
log.jokeFair: Polite. A few of them got it.
log.jokeBad: That was the wrong room for that.
log.riskOverboard: Someone is now in the river. Briefly. Mostly.
log.steer: You put the helm over and say nothing at all.
log.steerSelling: There is nothing to steer. The falls are not a channel.
log.wrench: You go below. Mid-sentence. Forty people watch you disappear.
log.bail: You bail. It looks exactly as bad as it is.
log.boilerCrisis: The gauge is past the red and the valve is painted shut. The only fix is more throttle.
log.boilerCrisisFix: You open her up. Into whatever's ahead.
log.waterCrisis: She's taking it faster than you can pretend she isn't. Everyone's feet are wet.
log.unresolved: You do not clear {label}. The Ginny finds out first.
log.pianoNote: The piano sounds a note. Perfect comic timing, no comic.
log.leopardGone: The crate has come open. The crate is empty. The crate was not empty nine seconds ago.
log.cleanSelling: You've sold it as hard as it can be sold.
log.clean: Clean water. Nobody noticed how close that was, which is the job.
log.fallsHigh: They rate the falls generously. They are lying, and they are lying for you.
log.fallsMid: They rate the falls honestly. That costs money.
log.fallsLow: One of them writes 'nine feet' in a notebook. You saw it happen.
log.salvage: You come out with a crate of ore and a story about turning around.

branch.title: The chart
branch.sub: Surveyed once. By one man. Some years ago.

ducks.title: The Two Ducks
ducks.note: The fast route is to port and everyone knows it. The other route is between them, which is slower, and wrong, and you are going to say the thing.
ducks.open: Two ducks, one either side of the sandbar. The fast water is to port.
ducks.openGoose: Two ducks. And between them, standing in four inches of water with its neck out — a goose.
ducks.funnySetup: Two ducks, one either side — steer between them and you get a para—
ducks.funnyFail: It's a goose. There are three of them and one is a goose and there is no version of this joke that works.
ducks.funnyLand: It kills. It is not the bit you planned. It is worse. It kills.
ducks.funnyGroan: A groan travels the length of the boat. That's a win. That's what a groan is.
ducks.funnyCost: The slow route costs you. Pressure climbing.
ducks.fastAct: You take the fast water and say nothing. The ducks go by to port, unremarked.
ducks.fastAsk: Someone asks about the ducks. You've already passed them.

settle.title: Welcome back to Cra-Zi
settle.note: Nowhere is three days downriver. It was three days yesterday. It will be three days tomorrow.
settle.summary: The room finished at {sat}. You told {told} bits.{leopard}
settle.leopard: The leopard is still out there.
